posts.cooked:
No, you cannot apply the same effect from the same card more than once. You can apply 2 different -1 damage effects (e.g. Smoke Bombs and Fortitude) but you cannot apply 2 Smoke Bomb -1s.

Can I recommend Spiffs excellent Rules & Clarifications document?
